title: Helium File
description: One benchmark file: Helium's and Silicon's verdicts per method, function and predicate, next to the code (helium_runs.members, silicon_runs.errors, viper_sources).

list.name: file
list.label: File
list.description: The benchmark file, by content: a file edited since shows once per version (@ its hash).
list.query:
SELECT vpr_sha256 AS __value,
       min(suite || '/' || coalesce(family || '/', '') || test)
         || CASE WHEN count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY min(suite || '/' || coalesce(family || '/', '') || test)) > 1
                 THEN ' @' || left(vpr_sha256, 8) ELSE '' END AS __text
FROM helium_runs GROUP BY vpr_sha256 ORDER BY 2

list.name: version
list.label: Helium
list.description: The Helium version shown; by default the newest that ran this file.
list.query:
WITH v AS (
  SELECT backend_version || CASE WHEN coalesce(dirty, false) THEN '+dirty' ELSE '' END AS version, min(started_at) AS first_run FROM helium_runs
  WHERE vpr_sha256 = ${file:sqlstring} AND backend_version IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1
),
tg AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (helium_commit) helium_commit AS version,
         CASE WHEN pr_number IS NULL THEN 'main' ELSE 'PR #' || pr_number END AS target
  FROM bench_targets ORDER BY helium_commit, pr_number NULLS FIRST
)
SELECT version AS __value, left(version, 8) || CASE WHEN version LIKE '%+dirty' THEN ' dirty' ELSE '' END || ' · ' || to_char(first_run, 'YYYY-MM-DD') || coalesce(' · ' || target, '') AS __text FROM v LEFT JOIN tg USING (version) ORDER BY first_run DESC

panels.title: Runs
panels.description: The newest run of each tool on this file (by content). Wall time is the median over the iterations.

targets.rawSql:
WITH hr AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (vpr_sha256) status, members, message, wall_s
  FROM helium_runs
  WHERE vpr_sha256 = ${file:sqlstring} AND backend_version || CASE WHEN coalesce(dirty, false) THEN '+dirty' ELSE '' END = ${version:sqlstring}
  ORDER BY vpr_sha256, members IS NOT NULL DESC, started_at DESC, iteration
),
br AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (vpr_sha256) status, members, message, wall_s
  FROM helium_runs
  WHERE vpr_sha256 = ${file:sqlstring} AND backend_version || CASE WHEN coalesce(dirty, false) THEN '+dirty' ELSE '' END = ${base:sqlstring}
  ORDER BY vpr_sha256, members IS NOT NULL DESC, started_at DESC, iteration
),
s AS (
  -- Silicon's latest decided run of the file; else its latest outcome
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (vpr_sha256) status, errors, backend_version, wall_s, message
  FROM silicon_runs
  WHERE vpr_sha256 = ${file:sqlstring} AND status <> 'SKIPPED'
  ORDER BY vpr_sha256, status IN ('VERIFIED', 'FAILED') DESC, started_at DESC, iteration
),
se AS (
  SELECT (e->>'line')::int AS line, e->>'member' AS member, e->>'message' AS message
  FROM s, jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(s.errors, '[]')) AS e
),
hagg AS (
  SELECT backend_version || CASE WHEN coalesce(dirty, false) THEN '+dirty' ELSE '' END AS version, percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY wall_s) AS wall, count(*) AS runs
  FROM helium_runs WHERE vpr_sha256 = ${file:sqlstring} AND backend_version || CASE WHEN coalesce(dirty, false) THEN '+dirty' ELSE '' END IN (${version:sqlstring}, ${base:sqlstring})
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT 'Helium ' || left(${version:sqlstring}, 8) AS "Tool", hr.status::text AS "Verdict",
       (SELECT wall FROM hagg WHERE version = ${version:sqlstring}) AS "Wall time (median)",
       CASE WHEN hr.members IS NULL THEN 'not recorded for this run'
            ELSE (SELECT count(DISTINCT split_part(m->>'name', '#', 1)) || ' members, ' || count(*) || ' results'
                  FROM jsonb_array_elements(hr.members) m) END AS "Members",
       hr.message AS "Message"
FROM hr
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Helium base ' || left(${base:sqlstring}, 8), br.status::text,
       (SELECT wall FROM hagg WHERE version = ${base:sqlstring}),
       CASE WHEN br.members IS NULL THEN 'not recorded for this run'
            ELSE (SELECT count(DISTINCT split_part(m->>'name', '#', 1)) || ' members, ' || count(*) || ' results'
                  FROM jsonb_array_elements(br.members) m) END,
       br.message
FROM br
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Silicon', s.status::text,
       (SELECT percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY wall_s) FROM silicon_runs
        WHERE vpr_sha256 = ${file:sqlstring} AND status = s.status AND coalesce(backend_version, '') = coalesce(s.backend_version, '')),
       CASE WHEN s.status IN ('VERIFIED', 'FAILED')
            THEN (SELECT count(*) || ' errors in ' || count(DISTINCT member) || ' members' FROM se) END,
       s.message
FROM s

panels.title: Members: Helium vs Silicon
panels.description: Silicon's verdict is its most recent VERIFIED/FAILED run of the file. Silicon reports only the members with errors, so a member of a finished Silicon run without an error verified; errors belong to the declaration starting at or before their line. Helium's verdict per member is the worst of its results (requires, ensures, body), from the newest run of the version that recorded them. Unsound: Helium VERIFIED where Silicon FAILED. Incomplete: Helium FAILED where Silicon VERIFIED.

targets.rawSql:
WITH hr AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (vpr_sha256) status, members, message, wall_s
  FROM helium_runs
  WHERE vpr_sha256 = ${file:sqlstring} AND backend_version || CASE WHEN coalesce(dirty, false) THEN '+dirty' ELSE '' END = ${version:sqlstring}
  ORDER BY vpr_sha256, members IS NOT NULL DESC, started_at DESC, iteration
),
hm AS (
  SELECT split_part(m->>'name', '#', 1) AS name,
         CASE WHEN bool_or(m->>'status' = 'FAILED') THEN 'FAILED'
              WHEN bool_or(m->>'status' = 'CRASHED') THEN 'CRASHED'
              WHEN bool_or(m->>'status' = 'TIMED_OUT') THEN 'TIMED_OUT'
              WHEN bool_or(m->>'status' = 'INCONCLUSIVE') THEN 'INCONCLUSIVE'
              WHEN bool_and(m->>'status' = 'SKIPPED') THEN 'SKIPPED'
              ELSE 'VERIFIED' END AS status,
         sum((m->>'seconds')::float8) AS seconds,
         string_agg(coalesce(nullif(split_part(m->>'name', '#', 2), ''), 'body') || ' ' || (m->>'status'), ', '
                    ORDER BY ord) AS obligations,
         string_agg(coalesce(nullif(split_part(m->>'name', '#', 2), ''), 'body') || ': ' || (m->>'message'), ' | '
                    ORDER BY ord) FILTER (WHERE m->>'message' IS NOT NULL) AS message
  FROM hr, jsonb_array_elements(members) WITH ORDINALITY AS e(m, ord)
  GROUP BY 1
),
s AS (
  -- Silicon's latest decided run of the file; else its latest outcome
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (vpr_sha256) status, errors, backend_version, wall_s, message
  FROM silicon_runs
  WHERE vpr_sha256 = ${file:sqlstring} AND status <> 'SKIPPED'
  ORDER BY vpr_sha256, status IN ('VERIFIED', 'FAILED') DESC, started_at DESC, iteration
),
se AS (
  SELECT (e->>'line')::int AS line, e->>'member' AS member, e->>'message' AS message
  FROM s, jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(s.errors, '[]')) AS e
),
src AS (SELECT source FROM viper_sources WHERE vpr_sha256 = ${file:sqlstring}),
ln AS (
  SELECT n::int AS n, replace(l, E'\t', '    ') AS l, substring(l from '^(method|function|predicate|domain|field|adt|define|import)\s+([A-Za-z_$][A-Za-z0-9_$'']*)') AS kind,
         (regexp_match(l, '^(method|function|predicate|domain|field|adt|define|import)\s+([A-Za-z_$][A-Za-z0-9_$'']*)'))[2] AS name
  FROM src, regexp_split_to_table(src.source, E'\r?\n') WITH ORDINALITY AS t(l, n)
),
lm AS (
  -- a line belongs to the last declaration starting at or before it, as for Silicon's errors
  SELECT ln.*, max(n) FILTER (WHERE kind IS NOT NULL) OVER (ORDER BY n) AS decl_line FROM ln
),
decl AS (
  SELECT d.n AS line, d.kind, d.name, coalesce(lead(d.n) OVER (ORDER BY d.n) - 1, (SELECT max(n) FROM ln)) AS last_line
  FROM ln d WHERE d.kind IS NOT NULL
),
mem AS (
  SELECT decl.name, hm.status AS h, CASE WHEN s.status IN ('VERIFIED', 'FAILED')
                THEN CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM se WHERE se.member = decl.name) THEN 'FAILED' ELSE 'VERIFIED' END
              ELSE s.status::text END AS s_status
  FROM decl LEFT JOIN s ON true LEFT JOIN hm ON hm.name = decl.name
  WHERE decl.kind IN ('method', 'function', 'predicate')
),
c AS (SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT members IS NULL FROM hr) IS NOT FALSE THEN 'no Helium member results'
              WHEN h IS NULL THEN 'not reported by Helium'
              WHEN h NOT IN ('VERIFIED', 'FAILED') THEN 'Helium undecided'
              WHEN s_status IS NULL OR s_status NOT IN ('VERIFIED', 'FAILED') THEN 'Silicon undecided'
              WHEN h = s_status THEN 'agree'
              WHEN h = 'VERIFIED' THEN 'unsound'
              ELSE 'incomplete' END AS class FROM mem)
SELECT count(*) AS "Members",
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE class = 'agree') AS "Agree",
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE class = 'unsound') AS "Unsound",
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE class = 'incomplete') AS "Incomplete",
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE class IN ('Helium undecided', 'Silicon undecided')) AS "Undecided",
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE class = 'no Helium member results') AS "No Helium member results"
FROM c

WITH hr AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (vpr_sha256) status, members, message, wall_s
  FROM helium_runs
  WHERE vpr_sha256 = ${file:sqlstring} AND backend_version || CASE WHEN coalesce(dirty, false) THEN '+dirty' ELSE '' END = ${version:sqlstring}
  ORDER BY vpr_sha256, members IS NOT NULL DESC, started_at DESC, iteration
),
hm AS (
  SELECT split_part(m->>'name', '#', 1) AS name,
         CASE WHEN bool_or(m->>'status' = 'FAILED') THEN 'FAILED'
              WHEN bool_or(m->>'status' = 'CRASHED') THEN 'CRASHED'
              WHEN bool_or(m->>'status' = 'TIMED_OUT') THEN 'TIMED_OUT'
              WHEN bool_or(m->>'status' = 'INCONCLUSIVE') THEN 'INCONCLUSIVE'
              WHEN bool_and(m->>'status' = 'SKIPPED') THEN 'SKIPPED'
              ELSE 'VERIFIED' END AS status,
         sum((m->>'seconds')::float8) AS seconds,

                    ORDER BY ord) AS obligations,

                    ORDER BY ord) FILTER (WHERE m->>'message' IS NOT NULL) AS message
  FROM hr, jsonb_array_elements(members) WITH ORDINALITY AS e(m, ord)
  GROUP BY 1

br AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (vpr_sha256) status, members, message, wall_s
  FROM helium_runs
  WHERE vpr_sha256 = ${file:sqlstring} AND backend_version || CASE WHEN coalesce(dirty, false) THEN '+dirty' ELSE '' END = ${base:sqlstring}
  ORDER BY vpr_sha256, members IS NOT NULL DESC, started_at DESC, iteration
),
bm AS (
  SELECT split_part(m->>'name', '#', 1) AS name,
         CASE WHEN bool_or(m->>'status' = 'FAILED') THEN 'FAILED'
              WHEN bool_or(m->>'status' = 'CRASHED') THEN 'CRASHED'
              WHEN bool_or(m->>'status' = 'TIMED_OUT') THEN 'TIMED_OUT'
              WHEN bool_or(m->>'status' = 'INCONCLUSIVE') THEN 'INCONCLUSIVE'
              WHEN bool_and(m->>'status' = 'SKIPPED') THEN 'SKIPPED'
              ELSE 'VERIFIED' END AS status,
         sum((m->>'seconds')::float8) AS seconds,
         string_agg(coalesce(nullif(split_part(m->>'name', '#', 2), ''), 'body') || ' ' || (m->>'status'), ', '
                    ORDER BY ord) AS obligations,
         string_agg(coalesce(nullif(split_part(m->>'name', '#', 2), ''), 'body') || ': ' || (m->>'message'), ' | '
                    ORDER BY ord) FILTER (WHERE m->>'message' IS NOT NULL) AS message
  FROM br, jsonb_array_elements(members) WITH ORDINALITY AS e(m, ord)
  GROUP BY 1
),
s AS (
  -- Silicon's latest decided run of the file; else its latest outcome
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (vpr_sha256) status, errors, backend_version, wall_s, message
  FROM silicon_runs
  WHERE vpr_sha256 = ${file:sqlstring} AND status <> 'SKIPPED'
  ORDER BY vpr_sha256, status IN ('VERIFIED', 'FAILED') DESC, started_at DESC, iteration
),
se AS (
  SELECT (e->>'line')::int AS line, e->>'member' AS member, e->>'message' AS message
  FROM s, jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(s.errors, '[]')) AS e
),
src AS (SELECT source FROM viper_sources WHERE vpr_sha256 = ${file:sqlstring}),
ln AS (
  SELECT n::int AS n, replace(l, E'\t', '    ') AS l, substring(l from '^(method|function|predicate|domain|field|adt|define|import)\s+([A-Za-z_$][A-Za-z0-9_$'']*)') AS kind,
         (regexp_match(l, '^(method|function|predicate|domain|field|adt|define|import)\s+([A-Za-z_$][A-Za-z0-9_$'']*)'))[2] AS name
  FROM src, regexp_split_to_table(src.source, E'\r?\n') WITH ORDINALITY AS t(l, n)
),
lm AS (
  -- a line belongs to the last declaration starting at or before it, as for Silicon's errors
  SELECT ln.*, max(n) FILTER (WHERE kind IS NOT NULL) OVER (ORDER BY n) AS decl_line FROM ln
),
decl AS (
  SELECT d.n AS line, d.kind, d.name, coalesce(lead(d.n) OVER (ORDER BY d.n) - 1, (SELECT max(n) FROM ln)) AS last_line
  FROM ln d WHERE d.kind IS NOT NULL
),
mem AS (
  SELECT decl.*, hm.status AS h_status, hm.seconds, hm.obligations, hm.message AS h_message, bm.status AS b_status,
         CASE WHEN s.status IN ('VERIFIED', 'FAILED')
                THEN CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM se WHERE se.member = decl.name) THEN 'FAILED' ELSE 'VERIFIED' END
              ELSE s.status::text END AS s_status,
         (SELECT string_agg('line ' || se.line || ': ' || se.message, ' | ' ORDER BY se.line) FROM se WHERE se.member = decl.name) AS s_errors
  FROM decl
  LEFT JOIN s ON true
  LEFT JOIN hm ON hm.name = decl.name
  LEFT JOIN bm ON bm.name = decl.name
  WHERE decl.kind IN ('method', 'function', 'predicate') OR hm.name IS NOT NULL
     OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM se WHERE se.member = decl.name)
),
pre AS (
  -- everything else (domains, fields, ...) as one row
  SELECT min(line) AS line, max(last_line) AS last_line, count(*) AS n
  FROM decl WHERE line NOT IN (SELECT line FROM mem)
)
SELECT * FROM (
SELECT line AS "Line", last_line - line + 1 AS "Lines", kind AS "Kind", name AS "Member",
       CASE WHEN (SELECT members IS NULL FROM hr) IS NOT FALSE THEN 'no Helium member results'
              WHEN h_status IS NULL THEN 'not reported by Helium'
              WHEN h_status NOT IN ('VERIFIED', 'FAILED') THEN 'Helium undecided'
              WHEN s_status IS NULL OR s_status NOT IN ('VERIFIED', 'FAILED') THEN 'Silicon undecided'
              WHEN h_status = s_status THEN 'agree'
              WHEN h_status = 'VERIFIED' THEN 'unsound'
              ELSE 'incomplete' END AS "Comparison",
       h_status AS "Helium", s_status AS "Silicon", b_status AS "Base",
       seconds AS "Helium time", obligations AS "Helium obligations", h_message AS "Helium message",
       s_errors AS "Silicon errors"
FROM mem
UNION ALL
SELECT line, last_line - line + 1, 'preamble', n || ' declarations (domains, fields, …)', 'preamble',
       NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL,
       (SELECT string_agg('line ' || se.line || ': ' || se.message, ' | ') FROM se
        WHERE se.member IS NULL OR se.member NOT IN (SELECT name FROM mem))
FROM pre WHERE n > 0
) x
ORDER BY array_position(ARRAY['unsound', 'incomplete', 'Helium undecided', 'Silicon undecided', 'not reported by Helium'], "Comparison") NULLS LAST, "Line"

Silicon reports only the members with errors, so a member of a finished Silicon run without an error verified; errors belong to the declaration starting at or before their line.               WHEN dm.h_status = dm.s_status THEN 'agree'
              WHEN dm.h_status = 'VERIFIED' THEN 'unsound'
              ELSE 'incomplete' END ELSE 'preamble' END AS "Comparison",
       CASE WHEN lm.n = lm.decl_line THEN dm.name END AS "Member",
       CASE WHEN lm.n = lm.decl_line AND dm.kind IN ('method', 'function', 'predicate') THEN dm.h_status END AS "Helium",
       CASE WHEN lm.n = lm.decl_line AND dm.kind IN ('method', 'function', 'predicate') THEN dm.s_status END AS "Silicon",
       -- keep the indentation: leading spaces become non-breaking
       repeat(chr(160), length(lm.l) - length(ltrim(lm.l, ' '))) || ltrim(lm.l, ' ') AS "Code",
       (SELECT string_agg(se.message, ' | ') FROM se WHERE se.line = lm.n) AS "Silicon error"
FROM lm LEFT JOIN dm ON dm.line = lm.decl_line
WHERE ${code:sqlstring} = 'all'
   OR (dm.kind IN ('method', 'function', 'predicate') AND (${code:sqlstring} = 'members'
       OR CASE WHEN (SELECT members IS NULL FROM hr) IS NOT FALSE THEN 'no Helium member results'
              WHEN dm.h_status IS NULL THEN 'not reported by Helium'
              WHEN dm.h_status NOT IN ('VERIFIED', 'FAILED') THEN 'Helium undecided'
              WHEN dm.s_status IS NULL OR dm.s_status NOT IN ('VERIFIED', 'FAILED') THEN 'Silicon undecided'
              WHEN dm.h_status = dm.s_status THEN 'agree'
              WHEN dm.h_status = 'VERIFIED' THEN 'unsound'
              ELSE 'incomplete' END IN ('unsound', 'incomplete', 'Helium undecided', 'Silicon undecided')))
ORDER BY lm.n
LIMIT 20000
